stateOfArt.subtitle: The project's bibliography, prepared once for all its studies: what is required, which works exist, how each is evaluated and which ones are used. It follows the method of Eco, Vyhmeister and Fee.

stepHint.candidates: Works that could help, from every origin. The same work from several origins is a single entry and ranks higher. Evaluate each one and approve it or discard it with a reason.
stepHint.approved: The bibliography every study in the project starts with. You can add or remove works later.
stepHint.toAcquire: What is not in your library. When you get the book, upload it and link it with «I have it».
stepHint.discarded: What was discarded, with the reason, so you can explain to the professor why it was not used.

empty.candidates: No candidates yet. Press «Find candidates» to gather them from the syllabus, the catalog, your library and the project's studies, or add a work by hand.
